QuestInfo.name: Silk for the Queen
QuestInfo.0: #p9074200# is in awe of the woman in your portrait.
QuestInfo.1: #p9074200# refuses to meet up with the queen empty-handed. Bring #t4033212#, put it into the #p9074204#, and spin it into a wonderful silk for her.

0.0: What a stunning piece of work! I must see her in person right away, but I need a gift! And not just an empty box with a hole in it, like I gave the last queen I met...
0.1: Let's see, let's see... how about... SILK?! Yes she can make a beautiful dress! Get me silk, immediately!

yes.0: Go get some Desert Rabbit furs and take them to the Magic Loom to make silk! There should be many on the west side of the desert. And stop thinking about how fur becomes silk! The loom is magic, I told you!

no.0: Treason! I'm going to have you tried for treason!

item.0: Weave some silk on the #p9074204# with the soft fur from the #m9810200# near the oasis on the left side of the desert.
